evidence.litert_version: 2.1.3 (guide device findings; the upstream skill is unversioned)
evidence.source_model: litert-samples skills/gpu-clean-conversion/SKILL.md symptom table, row 'SELECT / SELECT_V2': 'Replace with arithmetic: x*(1-m) + v*m'; corroborated by ~/Downloads/depthanything-android/docs/LITERT_CONVERSION_GUIDE.md (BiRefNet: 'Replaced SELECT/NOT_EQUAL'; Mimi: nn.ELU was a 'SELECT x13 blocker' on Mali)

expected_effect: the SELECT node is replaced by CAST+SUB+MUL+ADD; the SUB/MUL/ADD masking arithmetic delegates, so delegated coverage improves and the partition break at SELECT is removed (the bool->float32 boundary CAST may itself stay off the GPU; coverage still improves)
notes: Promoted 2026-08-19 (owner approved the recommended disposition). Validated only on the synthetic staging fixture, not re-verified on a real backend. Semantics: out = else + (then - else) * cast(cond) == SELECT(cond, then, else) for finite inputs; the mask is exactly 0.0 or 1.0, so lanes where cond is false are bit-exact and lanes where cond is true are within 1 ulp of float32 (else + (then - else) reassociation; fixture-measured max_abs_diff 3.0e-08, inside the default 1e-5 tolerance). NOT equivalent when the unselected branch holds non-finite values (inf/NaN propagate through the arithmetic form, e.g. masked -inf attention biases) — SELECT discards them. Assumes then/else broadcast to the output shape (intermediates borrow like:out:0).
title: DRAFT: Decompose SELECT into mask arithmetic (cast + sub + mul + add)
